branded.why: One dairy's or company's product, sold in its shops but no part of a food culture beyond them.

about.text: A soft cream cheese formed into small balls and steeped in sunflower oil with herbs and garlic. It was first made on Ryefield Farm in County Cavan, and since 2007 at Fivemiletown Creamery in County Tyrone.
